# Pixel-count-frequency rule: repeated sizes go to top, singleton sizes to bottom.
out2=[[6]*25 for _ in range(25)]
from collections import Counter
freq=Counter(len(ps) for _,ps in comps)
for col,ps in comps:
 rmin=min(r for r,c in ps);rmax=max(r for r,c in ps)
 size=len(ps)
 destmin=0 if freq[size]>1 else 25-(rmax-rmin+1)
 shift=destmin-rmin
 for r,c in ps: out2[r+shift][c]=col
[(len(ps),freq[len(ps)],min(r for r,c in ps), (0 if freq[len(ps)]>1 else 25-(max(r for r,c in ps)-min(r for r,c in ps)+1))) for col,ps in comps]
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in out2))
